subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should OpenClaw bundle this Wear real-time Talk surface and accept its RPC, event, channel, and language additions as an additive v1 contract, or require capability versioning or a narrower split first?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-proven, but automation cannot decide the permanent bundled-app scope or whether separately updated phone and watch builds may rely on additive semantics under existing v1 capability identifiers.

options.title: Approve additive v1 contract
options.body: Accept the new operations as optional v1 additions, require explicit mixed-version behavior coverage or documentation, then rebase and land the complete feature.

options.title: Version the Talk capability
options.body: Advertise a distinct Wear Talk capability or protocol version so new watches only expose continuous Talk when the paired phone explicitly supports it.

options.title: Split the API expansion
options.body: Separate the Wear UI and transport work from the cross-platform Gateway language field if maintainers want a narrower initial product surface.

recommendation.title: Approve additive v1 contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new operations as optional v1 additions, require explicit mixed-version behavior coverage or documentation, then rebase and land the complete feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The Wear phone-proxy and shared-protocol foundation originated in this person's merged work, making them the strongest available owner for the capability-versioning and bundled-scope choice.
